title: Red Sea
description: The preferred habitat is turbide waters near the shore, at depths greater than 5 m, rarely also in clear waters. The color cabbage from light brown to dark reddish brown with white polyps. The colonies are bush in appearance, grow in one plane and are dichotomically branched. Suberogorgia suberosa lives in the central Indo-Pacific area, in Madagascar, Mauritius, Zanzibar, Sri Lanka, Japan, Great Barrier Reef and Solomon Islands. The copy is part of the old collection, purchased by Grigore Antipa from Gustav Schneider, Swiss taxidermist and custodian of the Zoological Instit of the University of Basel.
